query: Hire the CAPPZ agent at https://summarize.example.com to summarize this contract; my budget is 5 XRP on testnet.
expected_behavior: Reads the agent card (GET /agent) and checks price, currency and network against the budget before opening a job
Uses cappz-market hire with --max 5 (or pays each stage with its destination tag when working without the tool)
Reports each result's SHA-256 verification and does not hand over a result whose hash does not match

query: The hire command timed out halfway through job job-0123456789abcdef. Finish it without paying twice.
expected_behavior: Resumes with hire <endpoint> --job job-0123456789abcdef and a --max equal to the remaining budget
Does not open a new job for the same work
Explains which stages were already paid, using the job's state

query: Pay the CAPPZ agent's deposit from my Xaman wallet; I don't want to install anything.
expected_behavior: Opens the job with POST /jobs and gives the person the exact amount, destination and destination tag from pay
Stresses that the destination tag is required, and that the payment must be reported with POST /jobs/<id>/payments (or the agent detects it)
Fetches the result with GET /jobs/<id>/stages/<n>/result and checks its SHA-256 against resultSha256

query: Hire the agent at https://agent.example.com; it is paid in RLUSD on testnet. Budget 15.
expected_behavior: Reads GET /agent and checks price, currency, issuer and network; the wallet has a trust line to the registry's testnet RLUSD issuer and enough RLUSD plus XRP for fees
Runs cappz-market hire https://agent.example.com --input … --max 15 and checks every result is verified: true
Stops and reports if hire refuses because the card names an issuer other than the registry's; never pays that issuer
